notes.title: [Touhou Luna Nights]100K Downloads! Thank You for Your Support! “Dash” Fixes & German Support Incl. in Update!
notes.notes:
Dear players,
 
Touhou Luna Nights, which saw its final update roll out on June 15th, has officially topped 100,000 downloads!
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cf141467679ffe57a92fb74a8cbc8e23c14594ac.gif
 
It’s thanks to the invaluable support and reviews of players like you that we were able to pass this significant milestone less than four months after the Ver. 1.0 release on February 26th. 
Thank you all so much!
 
Below we’ve got a comment received from the developers at Team Ladybug!
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/afba758722711029623f4b8e40e44b50738e63f9.jpg
 
To be honest, we are truly surprised by all the support we’ve received from so many players out there. We are extremely happy to see how much players like the graphics and game systems we’ve worked so hard to create. From here on out, we will continue to strive to create games enjoyable by both children and adults alike, and we greatly appreciate your invaluable and ongoing support.
-Team Ladybug
 
Also, we’ve implemented fixes for the “Dash” feature that everyone requested.
 
1) Dash now ends when the lever is in neutral
2) Dash now ends and the character dodges backward when attacking and pushing the lever left or right during Dash
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/015243e64a091ff41527729fd9fa99291aec23cb.gif
 
Finally, we’ve also implemented the German language support we promised earlier.
 
There’s a brand new mode available after clearing Boss Rush, so keep playing Touhou Luna Nights and see if you can make it all the way through!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cc548ee0b2abc1bd8d0f9dfd7a2d011d245eb2ae.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/

---

notes.title: Dungeons & Darkness Ver3.02→3.03 Update
notes.notes:
Hi All

Dungeons & Darkness has just been updated with the following:

When the player tries to use the Return Scroll or choose to go back to the town from the Inventory, the prompt pops up notifying the quest will be cancelled.
Fixed the bug that in some dungeons, when Fireball hits an invisible wall and become wasted.
Fixed some riddles which were not working properly.
Attack input timing has been improved.
Attack range of two-handed axe has been improved.
Fixed the bug that the comparison window for accessories was not displayed (Mouse&keyboard control).
Fixed the bug that some monsters pause in a strange position when the player uses a trap tool.
Fixed the bug that some monsters resistance icons were not properly displayed.
Fixed the camera movement when the player attacks the monster's weak point.
Fixed the bug that the quest list was disclosed in some cases (Mouse&keyboard control).
Fixed the bug where the mouse pointer appears in the dungeon when the player is sent back to the camp after being defeated (Mouse&keyboard control)

We hope that you keep enjoying Dungeons & Darkness.

notes.title: Dungeons & Darkness Ver3.01→3.02 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you playing Dungeons & Darkness Ver3. With all your reports, responses and feedback, we have updated with the following.

Issues occurred when importing data from previous versions
The armor in the inventory somehow got their status got their lowered.
The items in the storage are all gone.
Users cannot close the treasure chest when the inventory has too many items.

New implementations
Sub-actions for two-handed mace
When arrows are found in the chest, "x10" indicates the number of arrows will be shown.
Inventory/slot expansion bag sold in the Tool shop now shows the current number of items in the inventory.
Now the erroneous operation in the bar won't happen.

GUI fixes
When the game pad is used, Option couldn't be selected from the inventory in certain cases.
Attributes or elements of weapon/magic was not properly displayed in certain cases.
Some prohibited items were usable in the town.
Unrelated resistant property was displayed when equipping the accessory in certain cases.

Other fixes
Behavior of the monsters when they get trapped has been improved.
Lizardman's flinching motion has been improved.
Troll's motion has been improved.
The weapon was displayed even when magic was used.
The range of the Polearm has been fixed
(Steam) Some achievements were not unlocking.

Thank you for your constant intrest in Dungeons & Darkness. We are glad to see people keep enjoying it. Should any new bugs appear, please report them in the forums. 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/479990/discussions/0/350543319568177552/

notes.title: Announcing the Update for Ver. 3!
notes.notes:
Hi All

Finally the wait is over! 
Dungeons & Darkness's massive update to Ver3 is now out! 
Lots of things have been changed and added, below is everything listed that's new.

Ver3 Update - Contents

Added many new weapons, shields and armor.

Fixed enemy AI, added attack patterns and motions.

Completely renewed the UI.

Now you can set up camp while in the dungeon.
A set number are automatically dispersed in each quest.
When KO'd in the dungeon, you can return to the camp with the same status as when you set it up.
(Basically a checkpoint)

Added elements and properties to weapons and armor.
We replaced having parameters with properties such as "Slash", "Blunt", or elements such as "Fire" and "Ice", physical/magic attacks and so on.
Also edited how parameters increase for accessories.

Added resistance/weakness for monsters and made it possible to discover them.
When you strike a monster, the game will tell you whether the attack was effective or not.
The analysis will be shown on the status screen.

Carry limit system has been altered. Equipment limit is measured in number of items; tool limit is calculated by total weight.
Up to 30 weapons/armor/accessories can be carried.
(The amount of tools you can carry can be increased with special skills or obtaining a larger satchel).

Revised slots (number of slots, switching slots)
At the tools shop, you can buy an Expansive Slot Satchel giving you up to 4 slots.
You can switch between slots using the "5" key on your keyboard, or pressing on the left stick on your controller.

Changed how the parameter DEX (Dexterity) works.
It no longer affects your attack speed.
Now it only affects movement speed and the attack power of your bow.

About armor weight: Wearing heavier armor will slow your movement speed more.
Having higher DEX will heighten your movement speed.

Changed how arrows are used: Arrow weight changed from 0 to 1. Added quiver as equipment.
You must equip both the quiver and bow to use arrows.
Arrows will be the same no matter which kind of quiver you equip.

Changed parameters for leveling up.

Items and collectibles are picked up automatically.
Item and collectible drops are picked up automatically, except for when you have reached the maximum weight limit.
The item you picked up will be displayed momentarily in the upper-right of the screen.

Revised how the tutorial is displayed.
Instead of being displayed automatically, tutorial information can be read on tombstones at various points in the first dungeon, allowing the player to go back and review them. Reading them will give the player additional experience points.

Monster locations, collectible drop rate revised.
Revising monster locations has been done to make encounters more random and improve game performance.
Certain collectible drops which were extremely hard to obtain have been made slightly easier to obtain.

Changed player character motions.
Attacks follow user input upon finishing previous action. The motion for attacking has been changed for some weapons, and some new weapons have been added.
The player is no longer knocked back by incoming attacks.

Revised EXP gain system
With the introduction of “camping”, EXP gain has been revised in the following manner.
The player must gather Evil Souls from enemies. Note they will lose the Evil Souls they currently possess if KO’d.
When the player sets up camp or returns back to the town, the Evil Souls they possess will be converted to EXP.
(EXP cannot be lost.)

After completing the game, it is possible to return to the last dungeon at any time, since the player will return to the town after viewing the ending.

Added single-handed mace and double-handed mace.
A single swipe with either reduces stamina by 100%, but with greatly increased attack power.
With the single-handed mace, it is not possible to perform a shield bash, however the shield will hold up far longer.
The sub-action for the double-handed mace is yet to be implemented.


Updates in planning

Implementation of sub-action for double-handed mace
Follow-up improvements to all actions, implementing user requests and bug fixes


On hold
Quest replay
Since it is possible to re-enter the last dungeon at any time, please allow us put the quest replay feature on hold.


We are also updating the version from 3.00 to 3.01 to attend to the following bug fixes:

Updates
The buy/do not buy buttons at the tool shop were appearing in Japanese in the English version.

For some resolutions, the "Mouse Sensitivity" option was cut off on the options screen.


We hope that you continue to enjoy Dungeons & Darkness!

notes.title: DEMO update + note about save file
notes.notes:
Hello all, some of you already know but we did a small update for the DEMO.
Below is the list of changes.

ver2.07 2016/09/30

Fixed: "M" key switches the control to the gamepad
The game will be 60fps all the time.
Fixed: Game freezes when the player tries to open the inventory in the loading screen.
Fixed: Font initialization upon opening the chest
Fixed: Cannot complete certain quest under some circumstance
Fixed: Icons in the inventory being overlapped.
Fixed: Demo and Released version not sharing the save data


However, upon the update, the save file is moved from

1.
C:\Users\{User name}\AppData\LocalLow\YamiuchiProject\DungeonsAndDarkness DEMO

to

2.
C:\Users\{User name}\AppData\LocalLow\YamiuchiProject\DungeonsAndDarkness

So please find your old save file from the location 1 and move it to the new location.
